title: Formal smoothness descends along a faithfully flat base change
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that formal smoothness is detected after a faithfully flat base change (statement lines 38459-38464). The proof does not work with the lifting property directly at the level of the base: it rewrites formal smoothness through the characterisation by an exact sequence, checks the corresponding exactness after the base change, and uses faithful flatness to bring it back down (proof lines 38466-38501). Choosing the exactness formulation, rather than the lifting formulation, is what makes faithful flatness applicable. H2.
